notes: Upstream-clone debugging task on networkx/networkx at parent commit 5d160909eeb42e9844496dd2bbd19b826d2242d7 (real upstream bug, issue #8584 / PR fix 46a639aeb9bd4db8da444bd6a532df567b9a73cc). nx.SpanningTreeIterator advertises itself as an iterator but initialises its internal partition priority queue only inside __iter__; calling next() directly without iter() (both spellings are legal per the protocol) raises AttributeError: partition_queue on the first call, so the first spanning tree is unobtainable. The fix moves the one-time initialisation into __next__ behind a lazy 'if self.partition_queue is None' guard (partition_queue is pre-set to None in __init__) and keeps the StopIteration + cleanup behaviour. The pre-existing mst test file is fully green at the parent (all its iterator tests go through for loops) so the agent must reproduce with the given one-liner, read mst.py's iterator class, and reason about the protocol contract.
